name: TRIMA
description: This keyword returns the Triangular Moving Average value of the instrument. This keyword like all technical indicators are to be used under the Position keyword

This keyword returns the Triangular Moving Average value of the instrument. This keyword like all technical indicators are to be used under the Position keyword
